mission.title: About HiWhale Robotics
mission.text: Our mission: make every warehouse run as one intelligent organism — equipment, software and people orchestrated together, anywhere in the world.

positioning.title: A Solution Integrator with In-House Software & Hardware
positioning.text: HiWhale develops its own Orca-series iWMS intelligent warehouse management system and Blue Whale-series intelligent warehousing equipment, while integrating top-tier hardware from industry-leading manufacturers — delivering tailor-made, rapidly deployable end-to-end smart factory solutions for every business scenario.
positioning.text2: That means one contract, one system architecture and one team responsible for your throughput target, from the first site survey to 24/7 operations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: HiWhale Robotics ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect through this website, how we use it, and the rights you have over it.

sections.body: Account registration: your name, company, email address and password (stored only as a secure hash). Email verification: your email address and a temporary 6-digit verification code (valid for 10 minutes). Inquiry forms: contact details, country, product interests and your project description. Product favorites saved to your account. Uploaded files (product images, spec sheets, 3D models) stored in our object storage (MinIO).

We use browser localStorage — not advertising cookies — to remember your login session, language preference, AI chat history cache and dashboard preferences. You can clear this data at any time via your browser settings; core site features remain available without it.

Our AI assistant answers product questions using your conversation history for context. Conversations are stored in our database and are processed by DeepSeek, a third-party large language model provider, to generate responses. Do not submit trade secrets or personal data of third parties in chat. Conversation records may be reviewed by our team to improve answer quality.

We use collected data to: provide and operate the website; respond to inquiries and prepare quotations; maintain and improve our products, services and AI assistant; ensure system security and prevent abuse; meet legal and contractual obligations.
For staff and administrator accounts, we keep operation logs (who changed what and when) for audit and security purposes.

Account data is kept while your account is active. Inquiry records are retained for up to 3 years to support the sales process. AI conversations are retained for up to 12 months. Email verification codes expire after 10 minutes and are deleted after use.

Our servers are located in China. Data submitted from overseas is transferred to and processed in China to provide our global services. We apply appropriate safeguards for such transfers as required by applicable law.

We protect your data with encrypted transport (TLS), hashed password storage, role-based access control for staff systems, and isolated object storage for uploaded files. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, but we continuously improve our safeguards.

Depending on your jurisdiction (including GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, delete, or export your personal data, and to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. To exercise these rights, contact us at mia@gdhjtech.com — we will respond within 30 days.

We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be announced on this page before they take effect. Continued use of the website after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
For any privacy questions or requests, contact our data protection contact at mia@gdhjtech.com, or write to HiWhale Robotics, Shanghai, China.
